map

write .guidelines/.orders/INTAKE-RESTRUCTURE.md: the map, one row per path that would move

every row names the pointers the move breaks: CLAUDE.md, README.md, .shortcuts, package.json scripts, scripts/build-skill.js, scripts/build-templates.js, the generated skill and every relative link inside .guidelines

place the files of .scope/corpus-ledger into the axes they belong to, as rows of the same map: LEDGER, DECISIONS, INPUT-PROTOCOL, GLYPH-DIRECTION, HANDOFF-CLAUDE-CODE, plan/ladder.toml, scripts/ladder.py, scripts/audit_corpus.py, glyph-ems
every fact that would then live in two places, and name which copy stays
list the collisions as closed questions, each with its options and none answered

known collisions: dot-prefixed axes against the uppercase folders of _ORBITAL; ORD as the four-format bundle of glyph-cli against ORD as the per-agent order of the corpus-ledger DECISIONS; the order ID scheme and home still open as I_B1; the corpus-ledger DC against the .decisions axis
